title: ReferenceSolution
description: Known-good fix for one ActivityDefinition, kept in its own file (kind 'reference_solution') so it is never serialized with the activity. Used only for pre-serving validation (checks pass after 'apply', AC-J2) and post-completion review. Never given to the learner; never placed in the tutor context during an unfinished attempt (AC-J6, ADR-0014).

activity_id.description: The ActivityDefinition this solves. The activity binds back to this file by path + hash.

apply.description: Steps run in order inside the sandbox of a freshly started lab. Empty for activities without a lab.
